page.layout: One scan of a digitisation target card: a colour calibration chart (left, labelled QPCARD 201) and a grey-scale strip (right, labelled QPCARD 101 V2), with a printed label beneath reading "SUB Göttingen / GDZ | 2009". No book text on this page.
page.notes: No printed text of the book is present. The only printed words are the digitiser's label "SUB Göttingen / GDZ | 2009" and the target captions "QPCARD 201" and "QPCARD 101 V2", which belong to the digitiser's cover sheet and are therefore left out. The colour patches carry no text.
